name: Reverse Abs Crunch (Bodyweight)
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent at 90 degrees and arms at your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Curl your hips up toward your ribs.
longevityNotes: A strong, stable core protects the spine in every other movement and makes daily tasks — bending, twisting, reaching — safer. Core endurance matters more than core power.
overview: A reverse crunch that lifts the hips off the floor to train the lower abs.
